title: La Mora - upper melody of the sung repeat
source_location: York University JAC009399, p. 4 systems 5–6 from the repeat sign and p. 5 system 1.
scope: Upper note of each texted piano attack in the common bars and the two endings. Starts at the repeat sign. The pickup before it and the following continuation remain separate.
editorial: This single-line guide follows the highest pitch in the texted right-hand part. Lower chord tones and the piano counterline are outside the guide.
The first ending gives its final unflagged chord one eighth note. This fits the bar, the last bass onset and the matching three-eighth-note text pickup on page 4.
In the second ending, the first chord takes one quarter note. The four notes under the numeral 6 are treated as mixed-value sixteenth sextuplets, taking 4, 8, 4 and 8 ticks across the second beat.
The tie into the first ending is printed. The second ending reattacks its opening note where no tie is drawn.
The two small notes before the main note in common bar 5 each take one tick from that note. The vocal guide uses written pitch, an editorial quarter-note tempo of 96 and fixed velocity.
